summary.business_type: E-commerce (dental loupes and headlights, Iran, fa + en)
top_findings: Product catalog and blog are empty in the API (totalCount 0); no product or post page exists and the sitemap has none
Organization JSON-LD carries another business's contacts (info@rooshak.ir, roshak_kitchenware, t.me/Arash71tj) - app/[locale]/page.tsx:81-86
Template placeholders are live on /fa, /en and /fa/story (warranty, returns, payment, testimonials, founding year)
Homepage hero CTA links to /fa/products/1 (404); every category's parent-category link goes to /fa/categories/1 (404)
Consultation CTA lands on a wholesale cooperation form; no phone, address, contact page or e-Namad
quick_wins: Change the hero slider URL in admin from products/1 to products
Remove or replace the rooshak email and sameAs in the Organization schema
Hide blocks that still contain placeholder text
Set lang and dir per locale on <html>
Noindex or remove supplier pages content-admin and the Persian-slug test supplier

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS + HSTS preload and security headers

findings.title: <html> has fixed lang=fa and no dir
findings.description: app/layout.tsx:76 hardcodes lang=fa; dir only on an inner div (app/[locale]/layout.tsx:43-46). /en served as lang=fa.
findings.recommendation: Set lang and dir on <html> from the locale.

findings.title: Parent-category link 404s
findings.description: All four category pages link /fa/categories/1 (categoryTemplate/index.tsx:41).
findings.recommendation: Hide the link when there is no parent, or point it to the real parent slug.

findings.title: Dotted paths are soft 404s
findings.description: /llms.txt, /foo.txt etc. return 200 with homepage HTML and index,follow.
findings.recommendation: Return 404 for unknown file-like paths.

findings.title: Temporary 307 from / to /fa
findings.description: Costs ~775 ms on mobile; Link-header x-default points to / while HTML points to /fa.
findings.recommendation: Use 308 or a rewrite; align x-default.

findings.title: Empty listing pages are indexable
findings.description: Products, blog, FAQ, tags, discounts render empty states with index,follow.
findings.recommendation: Noindex until populated.

findings.title: /.well-known/* returns 403
findings.description: Whole path blocked, likely nginx or WAF.
findings.recommendation: Allow /.well-known/.

findings.title: Weak CSP and legacy defaults
findings.description: unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval in script-src; obsolete Host: in robots.ts:57; no IndexNow; rooshakshop.ir default in lib/api.ts:1.
findings.recommendation: Tighten CSP, clean robots.txt, add IndexNow key, replace default domain.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Category FAQ answers are direct and useful

findings.title: No products, articles or FAQ entries
findings.description: /fa/products, /fa/blog and /fa/faq show empty states.
findings.recommendation: Publish products from the official catalog and the pillar guide with sub-articles.

findings.title: Placeholder text is live
findings.description: Bracketed placeholders from messages/fa.json shown on /fa and /fa/story.
findings.recommendation: Hide placeholder blocks until the owner supplies real data.

findings.title: Weak trust signals
findings.description: No phone, address, e-Namad, dealership proof or real testimonials.
findings.recommendation: Add a real contact page and owner-supplied trust content.

findings.title: Unsourced health and spec claims
findings.description: Posture/neck/back claims and '4-6x magnification' have no source.
findings.recommendation: Soften and cite health claims; verify specs against the catalog.

findings.title: Thin category pages
findings.description: ~140-210 words vs ~2,250 for ranking competitors; visible 'SEO summary' box.
findings.recommendation: Add 600-1,200 useful words below the product grid; remove the box.

findings.title: Homepage H1 has no keyword
findings.description: H1 is a slogan; English tagline is ungrammatical.
findings.recommendation: Include 'لوپ دندانپزشکی' in the H1 and fix the tagline.

findings.title: Heading order and footer H2s
findings.description: H2 before H1 on category/brand pages; five footer H2s on every page.
findings.recommendation: Fix heading order; use non-heading elements for footer labels.

findings.title: Misdirected internal links
findings.description: Ergonomic-loupes link goes to the empty products list (landingFeatures.tsx:13); footer social links are bare domains.
findings.recommendation: Point links at the right pages and real profiles.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: aggregateRating only emitted with real ratings

findings.title: Organization identifies another business
findings.description: rooshak email and roshak social profiles in OnlineStore JSON-LD; separate @id per locale.
findings.recommendation: Use real Luca data, a logo and one locale-independent @id.

findings.title: Product schema lacks additionalProperty
findings.description: No magnification, working distance, weight; no mpn, seller, priceValidUntil; sku is DB id; currency unit unverified.
findings.recommendation: Map catalog specs to PropertyValue and confirm rial vs toman.

findings.title: Article schema incomplete
findings.description: No publisher, mainEntityOfPage; image not absolute.
findings.recommendation: Complete Article fields.

findings.title: Existing FAQPage on categories
findings.description: FAQ rich results retired May 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep the visible FAQ; schema is optional.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: LCP 1.4 s mobile, CLS 0.045, TBT 0 ms

findings.title: No CrUX field data
findings.description: Insufficient Chrome traffic; INP unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Re-check as traffic grows.

findings.title: 1 MB hero video
findings.description: Two-thirds of page weight.
findings.recommendation: preload=none/metadata and a smaller mobile encode.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI search and training crawlers allowed

findings.title: llms.txt is an HTML soft 404
findings.description: Returns homepage HTML.
findings.recommendation: 404 now; add a real text/plain llms.txt after approval.

findings.title: Little citable content
findings.description: Only 16 short category FAQ answers; no answers on price, specs, origin, dealer, warranty.
findings.recommendation: Pillar guide with question headings and direct answers.

findings.title: Inconsistent brand facts
findings.description: Manufacturer vs dealer, 'made' vs 'designed' in Korea; Iranian dealer unnamed.
findings.recommendation: Owner confirms facts; one self-contained statement mirrored in schema.

findings.title: Product gallery alt not Persian-descriptive
findings.description: '- view N' suffix and 'Product image' fallback (productGallery.tsx:35,54,87).
findings.recommendation: Persian alt pattern or per-image alt from admin.

findings.title: Oversized poster/logo; soft category image
findings.description: 5-8 KB waste; category image blurry at 1312 px.
findings.recommendation: Serve correctly sized images with sizes.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Publish real products from the official catalog

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Noindex test suppliers and empty listings; encode sitemap slugs
Hero H1, CTA and tap targets

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Sub-articles (TTL vs flip-up, Galilean vs prismatic, working distance, student)
Warranty, dealership, video, real reviews, e-Namad

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: IndexNow, robots.txt cleanup, real lastmod, CSP, /.well-known
